summary: The team held a kickoff meeting to launch a new remote control product, reviewing the agenda, introducing members, and outlining the project phases from functional to detailed design. They set a selling price of €25, a profit target of €50 million, a maximum production cost of €1,250 per unit, and planned to market the remote internationally in the US, Europe and Asia. The group discussed features such as multi-functionality, ergonomic shape, battery type and the need for a clear instruction booklet. Tasks were assigned for working design, technical functions design, and a user-requirements specification.
decisions: Selling price set at 25 euro per remote
Profit aim set at 50 million euro
Maximum production cost limited to 1250 euro per remote
Product will be marketed internationally in the United States, Europe, and Asia
Remote will be multi-functional, ergonomic and include a detailed instruction booklet

action_items.task: Develop technical functions design to ensure required functionality
